description.value: Corner Store is a grab-and-go market operated by UBC Food Services, located inside the UBC Bookstore on the main UBC Vancouver campus. It carries sushi, sandwiches, a wide selection of instant ramen, groceries, and snacks from local businesses, making it a useful resupply stop for cyclists passing through the university endowment lands. The store accepts UBCcard and Residence Meal Plan payments in addition to standard payment methods.
